final_candidates.decision_summary: Corresponds to N501Y, forming enhanced aromatic and packing interactions with ACE2 residues Y41 and K353 to significantly boost binding affinity.
Corresponds to Q498R, introducing favorable electrostatic complementarity and hydrogen bonding with ACE2 D38 and Q42.
Corresponds to Y453F, which optimizes hydrophobic packing against ACE2 H34 while preserving key interface geometry.

stop_reason.detail: Optimal affinity-enhancing interface hotspot substitutions have been identified and prioritized with high confidence.

history.rationale: Corresponds to N501Y, which establishes favorable pi-pi and cation-pi interactions with ACE2 Y41 and K353, significantly increasing binding affinity.
Corresponds to N501Y, which establishes enhanced pi-pi and packing interactions with ACE2 Y41 and K353, consistently conferring the largest affinity boost.
Corresponds to Q498R, introducing an arginine that forms strong electrostatic and hydrogen-bonding contacts with ACE2 residues D38 and E35.
Corresponds to Q498R, introducing favorable electrostatic interactions and hydrogen bonding with ACE2 D38 and Q42.
Corresponds to Y453F, which optimizes hydrophobic packing against ACE2 H34 and has been validated experimentally to enhance ACE2 affinity.
Corresponds to Y453F, which optimizes hydrophobic packing against ACE2 H34 while preserving interface geometry.
Corresponds to S477N, extending the side chain at the flexible loop tip to enhance hydrogen bonding with ACE2 S19 and Q24.
Corresponds to S477N at the receptor-binding ridge, slightly stabilizing contacts with ACE2 S19.
Corresponds to N439K, introducing a basic lysine side chain that forms an additional salt bridge with ACE2 E329.
Corresponds to N439K, forming an additional salt bridge with ACE2 E329, providing a solid single-substitution affinity improvement.
Corresponds to N501F, providing enhanced hydrophobic and aromatic contacts with the ACE2 binding pocket similar to N501Y.
Redundant with N171Y at the same position, where tyrosine provides superior hydrogen-bonding capability.

rejection.reason: Redundant with N171Y at the same position, where tyrosine provides superior hydrogen-bonding capability.

history.rationale: Corresponds to L455F, improving steric and hydrophobic packing against ACE2 interfacial residues without disrupting the RBD core.
Corresponds to L455F, moderately augmenting hydrophobic contact near the interface boundary.
Corresponds to E484K, altering local electrostatic potential at the receptor binding ridge while maintaining competent ACE2 engagement.
Corresponds to E484K, which primarily drives immune escape rather than intrinsic ACE2 affinity enhancement.

rejection.reason: Corresponds to E484K, which primarily drives immune escape rather than intrinsic ACE2 affinity enhancement.

history.rationale: Corresponds to T478K, introducing positive charge in the receptor contact loop that enhances electrostatic complementarity to the negatively charged ACE2 surface.
Corresponds to T478K, conferring negligible direct affinity gain relative to interface hotspots.

rejection.reason: Corresponds to T478K, conferring negligible direct affinity gain relative to interface hotspots.
